policy.direct_index_safe: HGSS used pixel indices already resolve to the same RGB colors in Platinum's normal palette.
policy.exact_normal_remap: Normal colors can be remapped exactly into Platinum's palette, but shiny-index semantics are not proven; do not bulk import automatically.
policy.palette_mismatch: At least one donor color is absent from Platinum's normal palette; requires manual art/palette conversion or rejection.
